caption: The drawing depicts a garment, likely an overskirt or apron, composed of translucent material adorned with an intricate black floral pattern. The garment is gathered at the waist with a gathered and pleated waistband, which is decorated with detailed lace or embroidery in tones of gold and brown. There is a large, soft bow on the left side of the waistband made of a light tan or beige fabric. The hem and vertical edges of the garment are decorated with a scalloped black lace trim featuring a denser floral motif. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the edges of the drawing are slightly faded. Handwritten text below the garment reads “Westchester County” on the left and “Drawn by A. Di Sturage” on the right, with some numbers written lower right.
title: Bonnet and Veil
